## Pass 1 — initial cross-artifact audit (2026-05-30, commit `40ece8c`)

Four findings, all localized to `tasks.md` task descriptions (no spec / plan / contracts rework needed). Three of the four were Constitution-adjacent risks (Development Workflow "Green checkpoints" rule): task descriptions risked an inadvertent constitution violation if a developer followed the task list rigidly without bundling call-site updates into the breaking-change commits.

- [x] **I1 [HIGH]** — `tasks.md` T008 vs T010: T008 changed `Node::new` signature (added `initial_subscriptions: HashSet<TopicId>`, renamed `peer_list` → `config`) without specifying a fixture-update clause; between T008's and T010's commits, `cargo test` would fail (fixture's `Node::new` invocation uses old signature). _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `40ece8c`): T008 grew a "Green-checkpoint update" paragraph requiring `tests/common/mod.rs` `Node::new` invocations be updated in the same commit, passing the sentinel `TopicId` from T005's migration as the `initial_subscriptions` argument._
- [x] **I2 [HIGH]** — `tasks.md` T006 vs T009 conflict on `src/lib.rs` CHK017-rename ownership: T006 said "handled in T009"; T009 said "Apply the CHK017 rename inline". Two tasks claiming the same edit, both with green-checkpoint hole implications. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `40ece8c`): T006 now explicitly owns the lib.rs rename inline; T009 explicitly disclaims ownership of the rename and owns only the new 002 re-exports._
- [x] **I3 [MEDIUM]** — `tasks.md` T005 marked `Message::ping(topic, n)` convenience constructor as "Optional". Without it, migrated test sites would need `MessagePayload` in scope, which isn't re-exported until T009 — green-checkpoint hole between T005 and T009 if implementer skipped the constructor. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `40ece8c`): T005 now marks the constructor as Required with the test-ergonomics rationale spelled out._
- [x] **W1 [LOW]** — `tasks.md` T005 cross-referenced "see T006 for the exact fixture wiring"; T006 is the CHK017 rename, not fixture wiring (which lives in T010). Incorrect cross-reference. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `40ece8c`): cross-reference now correctly points at T010 for the subscription-set wiring._

**Severity-weighted score (HIGH=3 MED=2 LOW=1)**: 9.

## Pass 2 — cascade audit after pass-1 fixes (2026-05-30, commit `3dd9d19`)

Seven findings. Five are cascade drift from pass-1's edits propagating into downstream artifacts (data-model + contracts + quickstart hadn't been updated to match the tasks-level mandatory constructor + sentinel-default fixture). Two are wording-precision in the same `tasks.md` whose paragraphs pass-1 edited. No new HIGH findings — convergence trend's severity going down even as volume nudged up (expected pattern per ROADMAP §4).

- [x] **D1 [MEDIUM]** — `data-model.md §2` Construction note said "convenience constructor MAY be added … non-normative". Drift from pass-1 I3's mandatory tasks-level wording. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `3dd9d19`): data-model §2 updated to "Required convenience constructor … rationale (MessagePayload not re-exported until T009)"._
- [x] **D2 [MEDIUM]** — `contracts/library-api.md` Message section had same drift. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `3dd9d19`): mirrored D1's wording._
- [x] **D3 [LOW]** — `quickstart.md` Common Pitfalls table said "or use the `Message::ping(topic, n)` convenience constructor **if implemented**". Stale conditional. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `3dd9d19`): dropped "if implemented" — say "(the convenience constructor is mandatory per the 002 contract)"._
- [x] **D4 [MEDIUM]** — `data-model.md §9` fixture-impact note said "Default: empty HashSet". After pass-1 I1, the actual default is the sentinel `TopicId` from T005's migration (empty would drop all 001 Pings under the new filter). _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `3dd9d19`): updated to "Default: HashSet containing the sentinel TopicId from T005's migration"._
- [x] **D5 [LOW]** — `data-model.md §9` said "assert_subscriptions helper MAY be added … non-normative, ergonomic only", but tasks.md T010 makes it required. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `3dd9d19`): cross-reference added to data-model §9 pointing at T010's mandatory addition._
- [x] **I4 [LOW]** — `tasks.md` Dependencies section label "T009 (lib.rs re-exports)" misleading post-pass-1 (T009 owns only the additions; rename owned by T006). _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `3dd9d19`): label tightened to "T009 (lib.rs new-re-export additions — rename owned by T006)"; T010's label similarly tightened._
- [x] **I5 [LOW]** — `tasks.md` "Within Each Foundational Task" note listed T005/T006 as single-commit breaking changes; T008 (post-pass-1 I1) is also a single-commit task but was missing. _Fixed 2026-05-30 (commit `3dd9d19`): note extended to include T008 as a third single-commit breaking change._

**Severity-weighted score**: 10 (cascade, expected).
